dashboard.empty: No campaigns yet. Import people, then launch from the scenario library.
dashboard.phish_prone_help: People who clicked / people reached (recent campaigns)
dashboard.verdict_default: Review trends and department gaps, then retest weak areas.
dashboard.verdict_improve: Overall rate looks manageable; watch department gaps and follow up high-risk people.
dashboard.verdict_attention: Phish-prone rate is elevated; prioritize retesting weak departments.
dashboard.dept_technique_help: Aggregated across campaigns. If a campaign has multiple techniques, each result is counted in every technique bucket.
dashboard.dept_technique_empty: No results with department or technique tags yet.
dashboard.dept_technique_error: Failed to load the department breakdown.
dashboard.no_trend: Not enough data for a trend chart yet.
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. Start from the scenario library.
campaigns.name: Name:
campaigns.steps_help: Add follow-up emails. Each later step is queued after the previous send succeeds, using the same recipient result ID.
campaigns.steps_note: With no steps added, behavior matches classic single-template campaigns. You can also use only the primary template above.
campaigns.trigger_on_reply_note: When set to On reply, a detected reply queues this step after the configured delay. Replies are read from the sending profile mailbox, which must be able to log in on the same IMAP server.
campaigns.step_page_help: Leave empty to use the campaign landing page.
campaigns.url_help: Location of Gophish listener (must be reachable by targets!)
campaigns.send_by_help: If specified, Gophish will send emails evenly between the campaign launch and this date.
campaigns.channel_help: SMS and IM reuse the phishing URL and tracking ID. Configure a sending channel first.
scenarios.lead: Browse built-in scenario packs. Custom templates and pages live under Settings.
reports.lead: Cross-campaign summaries and leadership brief entry points. Full brief export comes in a later release.
reports.brief_help: Coverage, phish-prone trend, and department comparison.
reports.trend_help: See the recent campaign trend chart on the workbench.
reports.dept_help: Find weak departments by click rate.
reports.export_hint: Per-campaign CSV export is available on the results page.
groups.empty: No groups created yet. Let's create one!
templates.empty: No templates created yet. Let's create one!
templates.envelope_help: This sender is shown to the user by most email clients. Defaults to the SMTP From as defined in the Sending Profile.
templates.subject: Subject:
pages.empty: No landing pages created yet. Let's create one!
pages.capture_data_help: If the landing page contains a form, submitted input (except passwords!) will be captured.
pages.capture_warning: Warning: Credentials are currently not encrypted. This means that captured passwords are stored in cleartext in the Gophish database. Be careful with this!
pages.redirect_help: This option lets you redirect the user to a page after credentials are submitted.
profiles.empty: No profiles created yet. Let's create one!
profiles.smtp_from_help: Set this to an email address from your sending domain to bypass SPF-checks. You can set the Envelope Sender in Email Templates. The Envelope Sender is shown to the user.
profiles.ignore_cert_help: Ignore common certificate errors such as self-signed certs (exposes you to MiTM attacks - use carefully!)
profiles.use_imap_reply_to: Use IMAP monitor address as Reply-To
profiles.use_imap_reply_to_help: Sends replies to the report mailbox. Replies are normally read from the sending profile mailbox; the report mailbox is for forwards.
profiles.imap_reply_to_missing: No IMAP monitor username configured. Enable IMAP in Settings first.
channels.empty: No sending channels yet. Create an HTTP SMS or IM webhook channel.
channels.body_template_help: Go template variables: {{.Phone}} {{.Email}} {{.IMUser}} {{.FirstName}} {{.LastName}} {{.URL}} {{.RId}} {{.Message}} {{.Subject}}. For JSON content-type the rendered body must be valid JSON. Map fields to your SMS gateway or IM bot webhook (no vendor SDK).
channels.confirm_delete: This will delete the sending channel.
settings.title: Settings
settings.imap_intro: Monitor the report mailbox for messages users forward. Replies to campaign mail are read from each sending profile mailbox, using this IMAP server and that profile's username and password. Do not set Reply-To to the report mailbox.
users.force_password: Require the user to set a new password
webhooks.title: Title
webhooks.name: Name:
webhooks.active_help: Data is sent only to the active webhooks
js.confirm_report_text: This result will be marked reported. The campaign status will stay the same.
js.confirm_delete_campaign: This campaign will move to Trash. You can restore it later.
js.campaign_moved_to_trash_detail: Results are kept. Restore it from the Trash tab if this was a mistake.
js.confirm_restore_campaign: Restore this campaign to the archive? Sending will not resume.
js.campaign_restored_detail: It is now in Archived Campaigns. Sending will not resume.
js.confirm_purge_campaign: This permanently deletes the campaign, results, and timeline. This cannot be undone.
js.confirm_complete_campaign: Are you sure you want to complete the campaign?
js.confirm_archive_campaign: This will stop sending and move the campaign to Archived. Results are kept.
js.campaign_archived_detail: It is now in Archived Campaigns. Sending will not resume.
js.confirm_delete_group: This will delete the group. This cannot be undone!
js.confirm_delete_template: This will delete the template. This cannot be undone!
js.confirm_delete_page: This will delete the landing page. This cannot be undone!
js.confirm_delete_profile: This will delete the sending profile. This cannot be undone!
js.confirm_delete_user: This will delete the user. This cannot be undone!
js.confirm_delete_webhook: This will delete the webhook. This cannot be undone!
templates.convert_links: Change links to point to the landing page
scenario_library.title: Scenario Template Library
scenario_library.help: Import a built-in email-link, calendar, QR, or Office phishing scenario. This creates an email template and a matching landing page you can edit.
js.confirm_launch_text: This will schedule the campaign to be launched.
